title: GH-5858: Add session ID logging in WebFluxMcpSessionTransport error handler
pr_description:
## What
Added session ID logging in the `doOnError` handler of 
`WebFluxMcpSessionTransport` and removed the TODO comment.

## Why
The `doOnError` handler was logging errors without any session identifier, 
making it impossible to trace which session caused the error in production 
with multiple concurrent sessions.

A TODO comment existed: `// TODO log with sessionid`

## How
- Added a `@Nullable String sessionId` field to `WebFluxMcpSessionTransport`
- Added a `setSessionId()` method
- Called `setSessionId()` in `handleSseConnection()` after session creation
- Updated `doOnError` to log the session ID with the error message

Closes #5858

@ArpanC6 Except the Javadoc updates, I don't see sessionID logging is happening here. What am I missing?

Thanks for the review You were right the session ID logging was missing in the WebFluxMcpSessionTransport inner class.

I’ve now made the following updates:

1) Added a @Nullable String sessionId field to WebFluxMcpSessionTransport.
2) Added a setSessionId() method.
3) Called sessionTransport.setSessionId(sessionId) in handleSseConnection() right after session creation.
4) Updated doOnError to include the session ID in the log:
`logger.error("Error sending message for session {}: {}", this.sessionId, e.getMessage());`
The TODO comment has been removed. Please take a look at the latest commit.

Since the sessionId is set inside the handleSseConnection() callback but can be accessed from a different thread in doOnError marking it as volatile makes sure it’s visible across threads. I’ve updated this in the latest commit.
